evidence: MiniGPT-4 demonstrates that aligning a frozen visual encoder with a frozen LLM via a single linear projection sufficiently achieves vision-language alignment
MiniGPT-4 is a multimodal LLM that uses a frozen Vicuna LLM extended with visual input via projection alignment
MiniGPT-4 proposes a two-stage training approach: large-scale pretraining followed by curated fine-tuning on 3,500 high-quality image-description pairs
